title: Cylinder Expansion Vessel Services London | G3 Diagnosis
description: Discuss cylinder expansion-vessel assessment. Diagnosis-led support, clear scope and postcode-based availability. Call 020 7205 4433.
answer: An expansion vessel must suit the circuit it protects. Identify potable hot-water expansion separately from the boiler heating circuit.

sections.heading: What the service addresses
paragraphs: An external vessel can lose its intended working condition or develop a membrane fault. Repeated discharge during heating can be one clue, but inlet-pressure or valve faults also need consideration. The engineer should assess the correct circuit and model before recharging or replacing a vessel.

sections.heading: Planning the visit
paragraphs: Some Megaflo models use an internal air volume, while other cylinders and larger Megaflo variants use external vessels. An internet instruction for one arrangement should not be applied to another. A nearby boiler expansion vessel is not automatically the cylinder vessel.

sections.heading: Clear scope and practical next steps
paragraphs: No homeowner pressure value or tyre-pump procedure is provided here. Assessment and any recharge depend on safe isolation, the appliance instructions and competent testing. Continued discharge after attempted work needs the cause reviewed.

sections.heading: Arrange an enquiry
paragraphs: Contact 020 7205 4433 with your postcode, equipment make and model, symptoms and access details. The enquiry is used to establish the appropriate work and appointment availability. Costs and scope are discussed before agreed work.

faqs.question: Is the red vessel next to my boiler necessarily the cylinder expansion vessel?
faqs.answer: No. Appearance alone is unreliable; the pipe connections and system design establish which circuit and appliance the vessel protects.
